original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚巴耶尔萨州一名沙石商贩死亡案：41岁男子被捕
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚警方证实，一名41岁男子Somkiemi Tommy因涉嫌谋杀沙石生意经营者Thankgod Kalaba在巴耶尔萨州耶纳戈阿被捕。警方称，Kalaba据报于2026年10月29日前往河边后遇害，遗体据称被绑在船上并沉入水中。警方在接到失踪及疑似谋杀报案后展开调查。目前该案为单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚警方证实逮捕41岁男子Somkiemi Tommy
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Nigeria Police Force has confirmed the arrest of a 41-year-old man, Somkiemi Tommy

key_facts.fact: 该男子因涉嫌谋杀沙石生意经营者Thankgod Kalaba被捕
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: over the alleged murder of a sand business operator, Thankgod Kalaba, in Yenagoa, Bayelsa State

key_facts.fact: 警方称受害者据报于2026年10月29日前往河边后遇害
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Kalaba was reportedly murdered after going to the river on October 29, 2026

key_facts.fact: 遗体据称被绑在船上并沉入水中
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: with his body allegedly tied to a boat and submerged in the water

key_facts.fact: 警方在接到失踪及疑似谋杀报案后展开调查
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the police commenced an investigation following a report about the victim’s disappearance and suspected murder

uncertainties: 谋杀指控尚未经法院判决证实，仅为警方所称的涉嫌谋杀
遗体被绑船沉水的细节为据称，尚未获独立确认
